name: Frieren: Magic Compendium
landing_text: A field guide to the magic of $(o)Frieren: Beyond Journey's End$() as this mod brings it to Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks: every spell, barrier, item, keybinding and cutscene, with real numbers.$(br2)Spells are learned and cast like any Iron's spell: scribe them into a spellbook or scroll, select them and cast.
subtitle: Spells of a thousand-year journey
